title: Aardvark Relic: Jetpack Flight West
summary: On a vast, windy plain, a lone pioneer crafts near an ancient stone relic, observed by a cartoon aardvark. The Inquisitor's mark on the stone is an alright warning. Soon, our hero battles hackers from a laptop, the constant jeopardy of their task creating a little mist. They thank an invincible system, pushing past gastric discomfort. Then, a malformed jetpack propels them across a sandstone ridge, dodging erratic warheads. Nostalgic visions of a holodeck blend with the threat of a murderer. Finally, wearing goggles, they speed westward through foggy fallows, navigating logjams and the unkempt remnants of a world under sanctions. This nutjob motorcyclist's journey is a desperate flight from larceny and umbrage.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: On a windy plain, a young pioneer crafts, watched by an aardvark and an ancient relic.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a vast, windy plain at golden hour. A lone farmer's field stretches thick with crops. In the foreground, a hoverboard rests beside an ancient stone relic, its surface numbing with age. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is crafting a makeshift antenna. A nearby cartoon aardvark mascot, the perfect pioneer, looks on. Distant smoke suggests a fire. The acronym for the Inquisitor's guild is subtly etched into the stone, an alright warning for any who visit. Laundry hangs limply in the strong wind.

scenes.sentence: Amidst mist and peril, the teenager battles hackers, their resolve invincible.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, working on a modified laptop. A small kettle steams beside them, creating a little mist that adds to the awkward atmosphere. Their earphone is askew as they evade hackers. The ever-lasting jeopardy of a faulty radar canister is clear on their face. Nearby, a newlywed platypus sportsman's luggage is stacked precariously. A goujon-shaped mop lies discarded. They thank a silent, invincible monitor, their gastric discomfort a minor worry amidst the tension.

scenes.sentence: A malformed jetpack, fueled by mysticism, reveals nostalgic warheads and lurking threats.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up of a malformed, antique jetpack strapped to the back of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls. The scene is bathed in harsh, erratic rim lighting. A jocular lancejack helmet sits askew. Nostalgic warheads are visible in the background, horizontal on a sandstone ridge, reflecting the daytime sun. Mysticism seems to radiate from the device, interdiction protocols flashing on a small screen. The teenager dehydrates madly, aware of the unjustly deployed trojans and the threat of a murderer lurking in the holographic projection of a holodeck.

scenes.sentence: Westward bound, the teenager navigates a foggy, unkempt landscape of abandoned dreams.
scenes.prompt: Overhead shot looking down on a foggy, widescreen landscape. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now wears goggles and is speeding westward on a junked hovercraft, a nutjob motorcyclist's contraption. They pass through unkempt fallows where logjams intersect, leaving an eggy scent in the air. A porthole from a derelict ship lies half-buried. The world feels unnerveingly empty, an umbrage hanging heavy over the sanctions that led to this larceny. They glance at a jitterbugging compass, its kissers misaligned, showing signs of kyphosis.
